pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Use the human-specified detector palette consistently in the main README rules and both current front-page envelope drawings. HCAL is `#cc6600`; labelled substructure may use lighter shades of its subsystem color while the base color identifies the whole subsystem. The regenerated LAYOUT-001 and LAYOUT-002 PNG/SVG views have exact subsystem colors, matching legends and FCAL hatching. Every plotted geometry coordinate and all physical input provenance are preserved.

![Updated front-page envelope drawing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/detector-component-colors/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-DES043-rz.png)

## Change

- Define all nine exact component colors and the stacked-histogram/legend rule in `README.md`; make the rule mandatory through `AGENTS.md`.
- Apply the palette in the maintained envelope renderer. FCAL zones share light blue and use hatching; the legend includes the eight subsystems present in these views.
- Regenerate both current DES043 PNG/SVG pairs and update their generator fingerprints. Keep historical layout controls and standalone FCAL evidence.
- Refresh PR112 interactions and canonical token accounting. Four finalized turns (three completed and one interrupted) contribute **24,080,277 input + 71,658 output = 24,151,935 observed tokens**, each counted once in its canonical owner. Cached input and reasoning are subsets. The current final-accounting turn is explicitly excluded; execution model/client version remain unknown.

## Validation

- [x] Independent comparison preserves every rectangle/line coordinate, axis bound and physical input field; only generator hashes change in named drawing inputs.
- [x] Exact palette RGBs and matching legends verified in both views; both final PNGs visually inspected.
- [x] Both PNG/SVG pairs reproduce byte-for-byte from the retained inputs and recipe.
- [x] Focused palette, geometry, provenance and deterministic replay checks rerun after the HCAL update. The preceding full local suite passed 79 tests; hosted checks run on the current head.
- [x] Deterministic FCAL study and historical pre-FCAL drawing checks passed.
- [x] Project records validated (85 tasks, 43 documents, 24 review rounds).
- [x] Infrastructure scope passes the existing path policy; no scientific progress entries or CI exemptions added.

Reproduction uses the existing command in `docs/layouts/README.md` with Matplotlib 3.11.2. Required session/interaction validation and token-site preview are recorded in the session journal. Hosted current-head checks must pass before merge. This PR changes presentation and accounting; it grants no detector engineering sign-off.
